Recommended RAG Experiment Run each query three ways: (1) BM25 only, (2) ChromaDB vector search only, and (3) Hybrid = BM25 + vector retrieval + RRF. For each method, inspect the top 5 or top 10 chunks before the LLM sees them. This makes it possible to determine whether a failure came from keyword retrieval, semantic retrieval, fusion, or generation. Expected pattern: BM25 should be strongest for exact identifiers such as Section 8.2 and SOW-ATLAS-2026-01. Vector search should be stronger for paraphrases such as 'cancellation notice' versus 'termination notice'. Hybrid retrieval should recover relevant chunks from both categories. This reflects the standard motivation for hybrid retrieval: BM25 provides lexical exactness while dense retrieval provides semantic generalization. IciteIturn0search0Iturn0search7I
